changelog: 演示 TaskFlow 业务流程编排与 ClawHub 入库串联：含 SKILL.md、references/publish.sh 与 references/flow.ts
summary: Orchestrate a TaskFlow-managed ingestion job that validates, packages, and publishes an OpenClaw skill folder to the ClawHub registry, then verifies the published artifact. Use when a piece of digital content (an agent skill) must move through a durable multi-step flow and land in the ClawHub resource center in a reproducible way.
